canonical_project: DataVolt TAS-1 IT Park data center
owner: DataVolt (Vision Invest); DataVolt IT Park Data Center JV LLC
notes: 12 MW IT-load Tier III carrier-neutral data center at Tashkent IT Park; groundbreaking 2 May 2024, site construction from March 2025; first phase Ready-for-Service by end-2026, second phase late 2027; up to US$150M 12-year non-recourse financing from DEG, EBRD, OPEC Fund and Proparco announced 17 June 2026; ~10 MW of the 12 MW earmarked for IT equipment (StanRadar); positioned as one of Central Asia's largest AI-ready green data centers.
